description: Abstract base class for implementing AMQP 1.0 services, managing endpoints, handling connections, sessions, links, and health checks.

classes.name: AmqpServiceBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing core functionalities for AMQP 1.0 services, including endpoint management, connection handling, and health checks.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the service name, used for container identification.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the specific configuration for the service.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns default secure port for AMQP.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns default insecure port for AMQP.

methods.name: addEndpoints
methods.description: Adds multiple endpoints to the service, can be overridden for filtering.

methods.name: addEndpoint
methods.description: Adds a single endpoint to the service.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves endpoint for a specific resource identifier or name.

methods.name: endpoints
methods.description: Returns all registered endpoints.

methods.name: setSaslAuthenticatorFactory
methods.description: Sets the factory for SASL authentication.

methods.name: setAuthorizationService
methods.description: Sets the authorization service used for access control.

methods.name: getAuthorizationService
methods.description: Retrieves the current authorization service.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Starts the service, including servers and endpoints.

methods.name: closeExpiredConnection
methods.description: Closes a client connection if its token has expired.

methods.name: preStartServers
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform initialization before starting servers.

methods.name: startEndpoints
methods.description: Starts all registered endpoints.

methods.name: stopEndpoints
methods.description: Stops all registered endpoints.

methods.name: startInsecureServer
methods.description: Starts the insecure AMQP server if enabled.

methods.name: startSecureServer
methods.description: Starts the secure AMQP server if enabled.

methods.name: createProtonServer
methods.description: Creates a ProtonServer with optional SASL factory.

methods.name: createServerOptions
methods.description: Creates server options, including TLS settings.

methods.name: createInsecureServerOptions
methods.description: Creates default options for insecure server.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Stops servers and endpoints.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the secure server.

methods.name: stopInsecureServer
methods.description: Stops the insecure server.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Returns the actual port of the secure server.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the actual port of the insecure server.

methods.name: onRemoteConnectionOpen
methods.description: Handles new secure connection, sets container name.

methods.name: onRemoteConnectionOpenInsecurePort
methods.description: Handles new insecure connection, sets container name.

methods.name: handleUnknownEndpoint
methods.description: Closes links to unknown endpoints with NOT_FOUND error.

methods.name: getResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates resource identifier from address string.

methods.name: handleReceiverOpen
methods.description: Handles receiver link open requests, performs authorization.

methods.name: handleSenderOpen
methods.description: Handles sender link open requests, performs authorization.

methods.name: setRemoteConnectionOpenHandler
methods.description: Sets default handlers for connection events.

methods.name: processRemoteOpen
methods.description: Processes an open frame from a client, sets connection properties, and schedules token expiry.

methods.name: processDesiredCapabilities
methods.description: Handles client desired capabilities; default does nothing.

methods.name: handleSessionOpen
methods.description: Handles session open event, default opens session.

methods.name: publishConnectionClosedEvent
methods.description: Notifies endpoints of connection closure.

methods.name: handleRemoteConnectionClose
methods.description: Handles remote connection close, cleans up.

methods.name: handleRemoteDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection event.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health checks for all endpoints.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers liveness checks for all endpoints.
